# About Culture Things

> Small-group day tours by Mercedes-Benz Vito and guided walking tours in Sintra, Lisbon and nearby regions. All prices are direct, per person and charged in EUR.

## Identity

- Brand: About Culture Things
- Base: Algueirão–Mem Martins, Sintra, Portugal
- Languages: English, Spanish and Portuguese
- Contact: aboutculturethings@gmail.com · +351 968 510 019
- Reviews: https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g189158-d28016472-Reviews-About_Culture_Things-Lisbon_Lisbon_District_Central_Portugal.html

## Current tours

- Sintra, Pena, Cabo da Roca & Cascais — van tour, 7.5 hours, €119/person; departs from 4 guests; meet at Sintra Train Station.
- Fátima, Batalha, Nazaré & Óbidos — van tour, 9 hours, €179/person; departs from 5 guests; meet at Restauradores Square, Lisbon.
- Arrábida, Azeitão & Two Wineries — van tour, 8 hours, €169/person; departs from 5 guests; two winery visits with tastings included.
- Sintra Stories, Old Town & Forest — walking tour, 3 hours, €45/person; departs from 5 guests; meet at Sintra Train Station.
- Lisbon Essentials: Baixa, Chiado & Alfama — walking tour, 3 hours, €49/person; departs from 5 guests; meet at Rossio Square.

## Booking facts

- Van tours use a nine-seat 2023 Mercedes-Benz Vito luxury van; this is not a bus.
- Every traveller receives a legal assigned seat; larger parties can use additional vehicles by arrangement.
- Shared departures are subject to the minimum shown on each tour.
- Monument tickets and meals are included only when explicitly stated.
- Free cancellation with 24 hours’ notice is stated on the website.
- Availability and exact meeting instructions are confirmed directly.
